design_decisions.f2.5-discrete-support: The paper treats its finite supports as finite-dimensional Euclidean coordinates and asserts Borel-measurable selectors; measurable-singleton instances expose exactly that standing structure in Lean.

proposed_from.topic: Fixed-design reverse-KL-regularized offline linear contextual-bandit learning on exact (C,D) shells: characterize shell feasibility, prove a universal measurable O~(dD min{eta/epsilon,epsilon^-2}) feature-coverage upper bound, and show that (d,C,D,eta) does not determine minimax difficulty by contrasting a zero-risk experiment with a pointwise-local Omega_{C,D,eta}(d/epsilon) experiment; no uniform D- or eta-dependent converse or persistent quadratic lower branch is claimed.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: Published axis: Zhao et al. leave nonmatching feature and pointwise coverage coefficients in the reverse-KL upper and lower bounds, and Ji et al. match the phase transition only after a tabular reduction. The precise advance is a matched \(d\)-dimensional linear result over one exact \((C,D)\) shell, including a hard family whose members retain both equalities. Repository axis: the supplied prior-proposal map reports no existing CausalSmith artifact on Zhao arXiv:2502.06051, Ji arXiv:2605.02141, or the reverse-KL \(C,D\)-shell question.

proposed_from.literature_map:
Zhao et al. establish the central \(D_2^{\pi^\star}\)-upper and \(C^{\pi^\star}\)-lower mismatch for reverse KL and state in their conclusion that it remains open.
Ji et al. identify the fast and slow regularization regimes and match them for multi-armed bandits.
Ji et al. explicitly identify linear or general function approximation as future work.
Li et al. provide a computable covariance-aware pessimistic linear-bandit architecture and minimax geometry.
Nguyen-Tang and Arora show that behavior-policy quality can require a function-class-aware coefficient.
Chen et al. motivate lower bounds whose packing controls decision loss as well as statistical distance.
Vannella et al. supply a linear-design information geometry ancestor for feature-shared lower bounds.
No inspected repository proposal names either Zhao arXiv:2502.06051 or Ji arXiv:2605.02141.
The chosen angle retains the exact-shell risk functional rather than comparing nonidentical inequality classes.
The efficiency, limit-law, and permutation lanes were generated as required alternatives but discarded because the gap is less directly anchored or lacks the needed symmetry.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3 and Open-ended Question 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The matched lower frontier is conditional on the constructed public experiment, the interior region 1<D<=C<e^eta with 2D-1<e^eta, and the explicit positive accuracy range.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The claimed matched order applies only to those nonempty interior exact shells and admissible epsilon; all remaining feasible shells are expressly unresolved.

banked_reason: Independent referee re-grade: subfield, not field. The entire D-dependence of the headline theorem is the definition of D unfolded once (lem:feature-coverage-domination is the Rayleigh-quotient definition of the largest generalized eigenvalue), and D is identically the published relative condition number of Agarwal-Kakade-Lee-Mahajan (JMLR 2021) adopted by Uehara-Sun, uncited here. The promised matching lower bound was not merely missed but proved impossible in the promised form, and the surviving upper bound is for a different, non-computable learner. By its own comparator table all six comparators are downgraded_to_informed_by and the pivotal one (Ji et al.) is unmatched. No causal estimand: under ass:reference-logging the logging policy equals the KL reference, so there is no confounding or identification content.
